comment: BreakageIncludesFirepitCooking (off by default): approximates the heat-then-cool cycle as a wear event on a fragile cooking vessel (pot, crock, dirtypot) the moment its cook finishes. Fireclay (crucible, ingot/tool molds) never rolls this: they carry no rudiments:Fragile behavior and never become a BlockCookedContainer, so the behavior's own gates already exclude them.
